follow-up time: From the 37th week of gestation until labour
cohort: 808 pregnant women at 37 weeks gestation and beyond were monitored before labor, and 49 pregnant women with 'one or more NCs' and 47 with 'no NCs' were analysed during labour.
finding: While there were no significant differences in most cCTG parameters or perinatal outcomes between groups, birth weight was lower in the multiple nuchal cord group and 1-minute Apgar scores were lower in the body cord group.
mod_finding: Foetuses with 'one or more NCs' evidenced a larger number of prolonged second stage and meconium-stained liquor cases, while the operative vaginal delivery and emergency caesarean section rates were unchanged.
birth_weight: Measured, lower in the 'multiple NCs' group
